from pathlib import Path
import subprocess,os,json
root=Path.cwd();work=root/'target/lua-native-hooks/memory-baseline';work.mkdir(exist_ok=True)
finder=Path(os.environ['ProgramFiles(x86)'])/'Microsoft Visual Studio/Installer/vswhere.exe'
setup=subprocess.check_output([str(finder),'-latest','-products','*','-find','VC/Auxiliary/Build/vcvars64.bat'],text=True).strip().splitlines()[0]
rows={}
for engine in ['reference','checked','rust']:
 folder=root/'target/lua-native-hooks/capi-proof-final-release'/engine
 lib=folder/('lua51.lib'if engine!='rust'else'lua51.lib')
 if not lib.exists():lib=root/'target/lua-native-hooks/capi-final-release/lib/lua51.lib'
 host=folder/'memory-baseline.exe'
 args=['/nologo','/O2','/MT','/DLUA_BUILD_AS_DLL','/I'+str(root/'vendor/lua-src/lua-5.1.5'),str(root/'crates/deadlib-lua/capi/tests/capi-host.c'),str(lib),'/link','/STACK:33554432','/OUT:'+str(host)]
 rsp=work/(engine+'.rsp');rsp.write_text(' '.join('"'+x+'"'for x in args))
 script=work/(engine+'.cmd');script.write_text('@call "'+setup+'" >nul\n@cl @"'+str(rsp)+'"\n@exit /b %errorlevel%\n')
 p=subprocess.run(['cmd','/d','/c',str(script)],cwd=work,capture_output=True);assert p.returncode==0,(p.stdout+p.stderr).decode(errors='replace')
 row={}
 for mode in ['--memory','--memory-default-panic','--memory-returning-panic','--memory-child-panic']:
  p=subprocess.run([str(host),mode],cwd=folder,capture_output=True,timeout=30)
  row[mode]=dict(code=p.returncode,stdout=p.stdout.decode().replace('\r\n','\n'),stderr=p.stderr.decode().replace('\r\n','\n'))
 rows[engine]=row
 print(engine,row['--memory']['code'],row['--memory']['stdout'],row['--memory']['stderr'],flush=True)
(work/'baseline.json').write_text(json.dumps(rows,indent=2)+'\n')
assert rows['reference']==rows['checked']
(root/'crates/deadlib-lua/capi/tests/memory.expected').write_text(rows['reference']['--memory']['stdout'])
print('panic',json.dumps({k:v for k,v in rows['reference'].items()if k!='--memory'},indent=2))
